ArgRef.description: AR[i] -- argument passed via CALL prog(a1, a2, ...).
ArgRef.title: ArgRef

ConditionGroup.description:
Multiple comparisons joined by AND *or* OR -- TP forbids mixing both
in one instruction (Ch.7.5.1).
ConditionGroup.title: ConditionGroup

ForInstr.description: FOR R[1]=1 TO 10 / FOR R[1]=10 DOWNTO 1.
ForInstr.title: ForInstr

IfInstr.description: IF R[1]>5, JMP LBL[10] ; IF DI[2]=ON, CALL OPEN_GRIP.
IfInstr.title: IfInstr

IfThenInstr.description: IF (R[1]>=3 AND DI[1]=ON) THEN  -- mixed-logic block form.
IfThenInstr.title: IfThenInstr

MotionInstr.description:
J P[1] 100% FINE ; L PR[5] 100mm/sec CNT50 Offset,PR[2] ;
C P[2] P[3] 200mm/sec FINE ; A P[4] 150mm/sec FINE (4D graphics arc).
MotionInstr.title: MotionInstr

OptTimeBefore.description: TB t sec, CALL prog / DO[n]=ON (Ch.7.2: TIME BEFORE).
OptTimeBefore.title: OptTimeBefore

PalletizingInstr.description: PALLETIZING-B_i / BX / E / EX header line.
PalletizingInstr.title: PalletizingInstr

PosRef.description: P[i] (program-local) or PR[i] (position register) motion target.
PosRef.title: PosRef

PosRegAssignInstr.description: PR[1]=LPOS / JPOS / P[2] / PR[3] / UFRAME[1] / UTOOL[1].
PosRegAssignInstr.title: PosRegAssignInstr

PosRegRef.description: PR[i] or element PR[i, j] (j: 1..6 axis / X Y Z W P R).
PosRegRef.title: PosRegRef

PositionRep.description: A /POS entry for P[i]: Cartesian (config + xyzwpr) or Joint.
PositionRep.title: PositionRep

SelectInstr.description: SELECT R[1]=1, CALL A  =2, CALL B  ELSE, JMP LBL[99].
SelectInstr.title: SelectInstr

SkipConditionInstr.description: SKIP CONDITION DI[1]=ON -- pairs with Skip,LBL[n] motion option.
SkipConditionInstr.title: SkipConditionInstr

Speed.description:
Motion speed with unit. Legal units depend on motion type (validated
in MotionInstr): J -> % | sec | msec ; L/C/A -> mm/sec, cm/min, inch/min,
deg/sec, sec, msec.
Speed.title: Speed

Termination.description: FINE or CNT0..CNT100 (CD0..CD100 on some options; not modeled v1).
Termination.title: Termination

ValueExpr.description:
first [op operand]* -- TP register arithmetic chain (Ch.7.3).
TP evaluates left to right; a chain may not mix * / with + - freely on
the pendant, so renderers should parenthesize per manual rules.
ValueExpr.title: ValueExpr

WaitCondInstr.description: WAIT DI[3]=ON ; WAIT R[1]>=5 AND DI[2]=ON, TIMEOUT LBL[99].
WaitCondInstr.title: WaitCondInstr
